P10b: In-game action flows
Seven storyboards on top of the table view. Each frame is a 520 x 320 crop of the table (board in the corner, teammate stand on top, own stand at the bottom). The full phone flow for Dual Cut is at the end.

g RED wire hit: screen shakes, red flash, explosion screen (P10c).
success   lift 120 + lay 320 + check 140 = 580ms
miss       shake 160 + needle 380 + token drop 140
red        flash 120 + shake 500 + screen 400

reduced motion: all become a 120ms cross-fade
timing
0 to 120ms wires lift. 120 to 440ms lay flat. 440ms check pops. Needle 380ms. Explosion 500ms shake + 1.2s flash.
